claude.sample_unit: patients with pharmaceutically-treated depression across five data sources

links.outcome: Difference between internal and external performance across data sources with differing populations
links.effect: Median internal-external AUROC difference 0.027 (IQR 0.013–0.055) in MDCR; calibration difference 0.329 (0.167–0.836); age distributions differed markedly (65+ was 0.7% in CCAE vs 97% in MDCR).
links.quote: The upper quartile of AUROC estimation errors is usually below 0.02, whereas the values of internal-external AUROC difference are higher; for example, the median error in the internal resource MDCR benchmark is 0.011 (IQR 0.005–0.017), and the internal-external absolute difference is 0.027 (IQR 0.013–0.055).

links.outcome: Model performance variation across external data sources (sites)
links.effect: Internal AUROC 0.61 vs actual external AUROC 0.587 in MDCR for one diarrhea model; internal-external differences exceeded estimation errors across AUROC, calibration, Brier and scaled Brier metrics.
links.quote: Importantly, the estimated and actual external performance is similar, e.g., when training a linear diarrhea model with a medium-sized feature set on CCAE, the internal AUROC is 0.61, the actual external AUROC in MDCR is 0.587, and the estimated AUROC is 0.585.

links.effect: MDCR median internal-external AUROC absolute difference was 0.027 (IQR 0.013–0.055), larger than estimation error 0.011 (IQR 0.005–0.017).
links.quote: The upper quartile of AUROC estimation errors is usually below 0.02, whereas the values of internal-external AUROC difference are higher; for example, the median error in the internal resource MDCR benchmark is 0.011 (IQR 0.005–0.017), and the internal-external absolute difference is 0.027 (IQR 0.013–0.055).

links.effect: CCAE-trained medium linear diarrhea model: internal AUROC 0.61; actual external AUROC in MDCR 0.587.
links.quote: Importantly, the estimated and actual external performance is similar, e.g., when training a linear diarrhea model with a medium-sized feature set on CCAE, the internal AUROC is 0.61, the actual external AUROC in MDCR is 0.587, and the estimated AUROC is 0.585.

links.effect: Internal-external differences in MDCR were calibration 0.329, Brier 0.012, and scaled Brier 0.308.
links.quote: The other metrics accuracy differences are even more pronounced; for example in MDCR, calibration differences are 0.013 (0.003–0.050) versus 0.329 (0.167–0.836), Brier score differences are 3.2 ⋅ 10 −5 (1.3 ⋅ 10 −5 –8.3 ⋅ 10 −5 ) versus 0.012 (0.0042–0.018), and scaled Brier score differences are 0.008 (0.001–0.022) versus 0.308 (0.167–0.440).
